title: Design-science evidence chain
author: Faye Niu
purpose: Show the valid design-science route from a relevant problem and frozen research contract through artefact construction, bounded implementation evidence, authorised frozen C0-C3 evaluation, empirical findings and proportionate research-question communication, while preventing implementation evidence from being relabelled as an empirical result.

status.interpretation: A methodology and evidence-class boundary, not implementation proof, comparative performance evidence or an RQ answer.

generation.pdf_backend: ReportLab deterministic vector operations with invariant=1 and PDF core Helvetica fonts

accessibility_and_print.greyscale_redundancy: Stages are numbered and text-tagged; the non-leap boundary, researcher rail and mitigation rail are explicitly named and do not rely on colour alone.

inputs.role: Frozen evaluand and C0-C3 contract, D0-D2 boundaries, comparable source window, independently labelled/adjudicated reference, analysis, reproducibility, ethics stops and student-as-builder/evaluator bias mitigation.

Separates source, implementation, protocol and empirical evidence; defines the design-and-evaluation contribution, researcher authority and the prohibition on engineering checks becoming overstated findings.
Traceable implementation and engineering-evidence contracts plus explicit separation of implemented, synthetic, protocol-only, restricted and human empirical states.

locators: Detailed chapter plan: 3.1 Applied design-science strategy
inputs.role: Approved target-section scope and evidence-calibrated dissertation argument.
Local academic-source admission, bibliographic binding, local path, page count, checksum, role and limitation records.

Relevant-problem, purposeful-artefact, build-and-evaluate and evidence-proportionate utility/quality/efficacy requirements.
Problem identification, objectives, design/development, demonstration, evaluation and communication sequence; evaluation measures results against objectives.
Leakage, unavailable artefact and under-specified reporting risks supporting frozen data/method boundaries and narrow conclusions.
Code, data, procedure, metric and reporting information required for repeatable and evidence-proportionate empirical conclusions.

limitations: The figure is conceptual author synthesis and does not report implementation or evaluation results.
It contains no sample size, prevalence, accuracy, effect size, confidence interval, time, cost, token, coverage, usability or human-benefit value.
It does not imply that all C0-C3 or D0-D2 conditions have been executed.
D0 synthetic mechanism evidence must not be generalised to restricted, real-world, participant, production or investment outcomes.
Freezing and versioning improve traceability but do not establish source, reference or researcher truth.
Independent or adjudicated labels and review may reduce one source of bias but do not guarantee validity or benefit.
The student-as-builder/evaluator role remains a validity threat requiring narrow conclusions and visible deviations.
The vector PDF is not claimed to be tagged; the complete TXT alternative provides a linear accessible companion.
